lines.rhythm.title: STEP UP!
lines.rhythm.tagline: FOUR LANES, TWO SONGS, ONE GROOVE
lines.rhythm.calibrate.how.touch: TAP ON EACH CLICK YOU HEAR
lines.rhythm.calibrate.how.keys: PRESS A LANE KEY ON EACH CLICK YOU HEAR
lines.rhythm.calibrate.done: YOUR OFFSET: {ms} MS  ({taps} TAPS, 12 SETS IT)
lines.rhythm.calibrate.keep.touch: BACK: KEEP THE OLD ONE ({ms} MS)
lines.rhythm.calibrate.keep.keys: ESCAPE: KEEP THE OLD ONE ({ms} MS)
lines.rhythm.after.title: TITLE
lines.rhythm.how.touch: TAP THE COLUMN AS A NOTE MEETS ITS RING
lines.rhythm.how.keys: {key:l0} {key:l1} {key:l2} {key:l3} (OR THE ARROWS) AS A NOTE MEETS ITS RING

notes.rhythm.title: The rhythm game's name on its menu (after Dance Dance Revolution and PaRappa the Rapper): a cheerful call to dance.
notes.rhythm.song.stepup: The first song's name (the game's own title without the !).
notes.rhythm.song.stepup.about: The first song in a line: notes on four lanes, jumps (two at once), holds (a note held down).
notes.rhythm.song.rapschool: The second song's name: a rap lesson (PaRappa the Rapper).
notes.rhythm.song.rapschool.about: Master Beat, the teacher, raps a line and you answer it, bar for bar.
notes.rhythm.calibrate: The calibration screen (a menu choice and its title): it sets the audio offset by tapping on clicks.
notes.rhythm.calibrate.about: Under CALIBRATE in the menu: the offset now, in milliseconds.
notes.rhythm.calibrate.done: The offset found, in milliseconds, after {taps} taps; 12 taps set it and end the screen.
notes.rhythm.calibrate.taps: Taps so far of the 8 it needs.
notes.rhythm.calibrate.keep.touch: A phone's back gesture leaves the screen, keeping the offset it had.
notes.rhythm.calibrate.keep.keys: The Escape key leaves the screen, keeping the offset it had.
notes.rhythm.after.songs: After a song: back to the menu of songs.
notes.rhythm.result.failed: The results' top line: {song} is the song's name; FAILED when the life gauge ran out.
notes.rhythm.result.clear: The results' top line: the song played to its end.
notes.rhythm.result.counts1: The results: how many notes were judged perfect and great (the judgments' words as in rhythm.judge).
notes.rhythm.result.counts2: The results: how many good and missed.
notes.rhythm.result.combo: The results: the longest run of notes hit in a row, and the score.
notes.rhythm.life: Beside the life gauge (empty: the song fails).
notes.rhythm.judge.perfect: A judgment over the lane as a note is hit: the best timing. Shown big for a moment.
notes.rhythm.judge.good: A judgment: further off, still a hit.
notes.rhythm.ready: Over the stage before the first notes; a count-down (3, 2, 1) follows it.
notes.rhythm.turn.master: RAP SCHOOL: over the teacher while it is his bar to rap. Master Beat is his name.
notes.rhythm.turn.you: RAP SCHOOL: over the teacher's line while it is the player's bar to answer.
notes.rhythm.how.keys: Help as a song starts: the four lane keys ({key:l0} to {key:l3}, D F J K) or the arrow keys, pressed as a note reaches its ring.
notes.rhythm.how.touch: The same on a touch screen: the screen's four columns are the lanes.
notes.action.l0: The first (left) lane's key, on the controls screen: L 0 is lane 0.

brief: The rhythm slice: STEP UP!, a dance club where a dancer moves to the beat and to each note you hit (after Dance Dance Revolution, Beatmania and PaRappa the Rapper). Two songs: STEP UP (arrows on four lanes) and RAP SCHOOL, where the teacher, Master Beat (a man), raps a line and you answer it. Upbeat and short: arcade capitals on a small screen. The player is unseen; address them with the familiar "you".
